---
title: Panzanella
id: MAR-0054
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 6
time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 7 slices of stale bread
- 3 tomato
- 1 spring onion
- 0.5 cucumber
- 2 basil sprig
- 1 scant dl extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Soak the bread slices in water for 10-15 minutes, then squeeze them and crumble them into a bowl.
2. Wash the tomatoes and cut them into small cubes; thinly slice the spring onion and cucumber; wash, dry the basil leaves and tear them with your hands.
3. Add the prepared vegetables to the bread, then season with the oil and flavor with salt and pepper.
4. Mix, finish with the basil and serve.
